bioParagraphs: I am a Computer Science and Engineering graduate from Daffodil International University with research interests in Artificial Intelligence, Digital Health, and Trustworthy AI. My expertise spans Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Human–Computer Interaction, Data Mining, Data Management, Health Information Systems, Information Systems, Computer Security, Data Privacy, and AI Governance.

As a Research Associate & Coordinator at the Health Informatics Research Lab (HIRL), I contribute to AI-driven healthcare research, project coordination, and researcher mentorship. I also worked as a Generative AI Intern at Metademy LLC, USA, developing Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications and AI agents.

My research focuses on building intelligent, privacy-preserving, and clinically interpretable AI systems for healthcare and digital health applications. I strongly believe in the importance of outreach in academia and actively mentor junior researchers, organize research workshops, and lead collaborative research programs.

papers.title: Beat-by-Beat Lead-Aware ECG Segmentation and Multi-Class Cardiac Disease Classification
papers.authorsHtml: Md. Moinul Islam, Sadia Sultana Chowa, Md. Zahid Hasan, and Sami Azam
papers.abstractHtml: This study proposes a beat-by-beat lead-aware ECG segmentation approach coupled with multi-class cardiac disease classification. Our method addresses the challenge of accurate ECG signal analysis by incorporating lead-specific information into the segmentation process, enabling more precise identification of cardiac waveforms and improving automated cardiac diagnostics through fine-grained signal analysis.

papers.title: IKDEFL: An Independent Knowledge Distillation Enhanced Federated Learning Framework for Ear Disease Detection
papers.authorsHtml: Md. Moinul Islam, Ashabori Mayurakkhi, Rokeya Unzum Shekha, Md. Zahid Hasan, Md Jamil Istiaq, and Dewan Aminul Islam.
papers.abstractHtml: IKDEFL introduces an independent knowledge distillation enhanced federated learning framework for ear disease detection. By combining federated learning with independent knowledge distillation across distributed clients, the framework trains efficient and accurate diagnostic models while keeping patient data local and privacy preserved.

papers.title: CoughScreen-BD: A Non-Invasive Acoustic Deep Learning Framework
papers.abstractHtml: CoughScreen-BD is an ongoing project developing a non-invasive acoustic deep learning framework for respiratory health screening from cough sounds. The work targets low-cost, accessible screening suited to resource-constrained clinical settings.

papers.title: Clinically Explainable Visual Question Answering (X-VQA) for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy
papers.abstractHtml: This work presents X-VQA, a clinically explainable Visual Question Answering framework designed specifically for gastrointestinal endoscopy. The system integrates visual and textual reasoning to provide interpretable diagnostic support, addressing the critical need for transparency in AI-assisted medical diagnosis.
